description: Render the film to MP4 files (H.264, 60 fps, sound mixed and mastered) in the working folder's exports/, one per format. Each file is checked for dangerous flashes. With `as`, a project for another program instead, one ZIP per format: after-effects (a script After Effects runs to rebuild the film: a composition per scene, the texts live, every element's motion as keyframes, the drawings as pictures, the camera, the transitions rendered, the mix, a README) or resolve (a timeline for DaVinci Resolve with the scenes rendered, and a Fusion file per scene). The plan decides which formats and definitions are open; premium pieces need a paid plan; with an account key on the free plan, each file (a film or a project, in one format) is one export, 3 a month (and at most 6 in 30 days for the free accounts of one internet connection together), and a refusal says when they come back: tell the person as it is. A long job: progress is reported to a client that asks for it, and a cancelled request stops the render. Run check_film first.

as.description: video (default): MP4 files; after-effects or resolve: a project for that program (ZIP)

name.description: The film's name in the working folder (see list_films)

name: export_film
title: Export a film
